gloss: message board; notice board; communication board

definitions.gloss: message board; notice board; communication board
definitions.explanation: A physical or digital board used to post messages, announcements, and notices for a group. Common in schools, workplaces, and community settings.

examples.japanese: {連絡板|れんらくばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧おいた。
examples.english: I wrote the schedule on the message board.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連絡板|れんらくばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}ってある→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: An important notice is posted on the message board.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連絡板|れんらくばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧になっている。
examples.english: It has become a habit to check the company message board every day.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧ (communication, contact) and {板|ばん} (board). Can refer to a physical bulletin board or an online message board. In Japanese schools, information is often communicated to parents through a ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (communication notebook) rather than a board.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連絡板|れんらくばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write on the message board
- {連絡板|れんらくばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the message board
- {連絡板|れんらくばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to post on the message board
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧{連絡板|れんらくばん}: company notice board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧: bulletin board — a more general term that also refers to internet forums
- ⟦{伝言板|でんごんばん}→伝言板：16788_dengonban⟧: message board (for personal messages) — a board for leaving individual messages for specific people
- {連絡帳|れんらくちょう}: communication notebook — a school notebook for messages between teachers and parents
